items.headline: Dubai outlines eligible family members for retiree 5-year Golden Visas
items.summary: Authorities have specified which relatives can secure residence permits via retirees holding the 5-year Golden Visa. This update clarifies sponsorship rules for aging investors.
items.why: It clarifies residency eligibility rules for family members of retirees.

items.headline: UAE clarifies family residency status upon a Golden Visa holder's death
items.summary: Guidelines have been released explaining procedures for family members when a primary Golden Visa holder passes away. This provides legal certainty for dependents.
items.why: It outlines important residency regulations for dependents of visa holders.
items.impact_reason: Clarifies legal residency rules for dependents.

bullets: On Thursday 5 November, Dubai recorded 485 sales worth AED 1.2bn, which is 0.1% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 65.4% of Thursday's sales, compared to a 7-day average of 54.2%.
The median price was AED 1,686 per sq ft, up 0.8% over the last 30 days and down 5.4% from last year.
Busiest areas over the last 7 days were JVC with 220 sales, Dubai South with 208 sales, and Liwan1 with 184 sales.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Abu Dhabi property deals topped Dh171 billion in nine months, showing major sales volume increases in the UAE capital.
Abu Dhabi property transactions increased by 76.1% in nine months, providing official market performance figures for the capital.
Dubai has outlined eligible family members for retiree 5-year Golden Visas and clarified family residency status upon a Golden Visa holder's death.
